note: The two Baseball-Reference bulk WAR data files DISI already cites for team-season bWAR (war_daily_bat.txt, war_daily_pitch.txt; source type WAR_DATA_FILE, tier BASEBALL_REFERENCE), read as archived Internet Archive captures of the exact original URLs because the live files answer HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge). Archived original-source material, never a secondary WAR table: BWAR != FWAR. Each capture is pinned three ways: the Internet Archive CDX digest (SHA-1, base32) of the archived payload, the SHA-256 of that payload as served (gzip), and the SHA-256 of the decoded file the rows are read from. The decoded files are not committed (research-output/057-work/raw/, gitignored); fetch-sources.mjs retrieves and verifies them.
